evaluation_improvement_plan_007.evidence: Teachers who receive a “needs improvement” rating for two consecutive semesters shall be eligible to be referred to the PAR program, and shall be admitted by the mutual agreement of the Co-Chairs.

evaluation_consequences_008.evidence: A teacher who has exited the PAR program and subsequently receives an unsatisfactory notice may subsequently be moved to dismissal by the district in accordance with due process as provided in the Education Code.
